statement: Whenever is_cousins(root,x,y) returns a result r, r is true if and only if depth(root,x) = depth(root,y), this common depth is at least 1, and the parent of the node with value x in root is a different node from the parent of the node with value y in root. Here depth(root,v) is the number of edges on the path from the root node (which has depth 0) to the unique node with value v, and the parent of a non-root node is the immediate predecessor of that node on this path. In all other cases, including when either node has no parent, r is false.
preconditions: root is a Tree with between 2 and 100 Node constructors inclusive; every node value lies in the integer interval [1,100]; all node values in root are distinct; x and y are distinct values and each occurs exactly once in root.
